Globally, **complications of premature birth** were the leading cause of death among children under five as of 2017, accounting for about 18% of deaths in the [2017 UN child mortality report](https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/358381508420391876/pdf/120551-REVISED-PUBLIC-IGME-report-2017-child-mortality-final.pdf). Pneumonia was the leading infectious cause, accounting for about 16%.
